name: Boğaziçi University
tuitionNote: Per official 2025-2026 international-quota fee schedule (bogazici.edu.tr), per-semester fees range USD 4,000-5,000 depending on faculty (Engineering/Economics & Admin Sciences USD 5,000/semester ≈ USD 9,000-10,000/yr; most other faculties USD 4,000/semester ≈ USD 8,000/yr). Used a mid-range representative figure of ~USD 4,500/yr equivalent converted at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR. Graduate (foreign-citizenship) fees are generally lower per semester; figure used is approximate — verify exact per-faculty amount before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma equivalent to Turkish secondary education + international exam scores (SAT/ACT or equivalent) or Boğaziçi's own placement exam route + English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS) as Boğaziçi is English-medium
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field + ALES (or GRE/GMAT) + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT ~85+ or IELTS 6.5+) + department-specific requirements
scholarshipDetails: Boğaziçi University is a confirmed host institution for Türkiye Bursları (Turkey Scholarships), the Turkish government's fully-funded scholarship program open to Bangladeshi applicants, covering full tuition, monthly stipend, free accommodation, one-year Turkish language course, health insurance, and round-trip airfare. Apply via turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.

name: Middle East Technical University (METU)
tuitionNote: Per METU International Students Office 2024-2025 fee schedule (iso.metu.edu.tr): undergraduate international tuition USD 1,000-1,500/yr (or TRY equivalent, whichever is higher per Turkish Official Gazette minimums), graduate USD 750/yr equivalent. Used USD 1,250/yr (bachelor) and USD 750/yr (master) converted at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR. Note: actual TRY-converted amount can exceed the USD figure depending on exchange rate set by the Central Bank one week before payment — verify exact current-year figure before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma + valid international exam scores (SAT, ACT, or national university entrance exam equivalent) + English proficiency (METU is fully English-medium; TOEFL iBT 87+ or IELTS 6.0+ unless exempt)
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field + ALES or GRE/GMAT + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 87+ or IELTS 6.0+) + department-specific minimum GPA
scholarshipDetails: METU is a confirmed Türkiye Bursları host university, offering Bangladeshi students full tuition coverage, monthly stipend, free accommodation, one-year Turkish language preparation, health insurance, and round-trip airfare. Apply via turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.

name: Istanbul Technical University (ITU)
tuitionNote: Per ITU Student Information System (sis.itu.edu.tr) 2025-2026 fee tables, undergraduate international tuition is reported in the range of approximately USD 1,500-5,000/yr depending on program/engineering discipline, graduate USD 2,000-5,000/yr. Used a representative mid-range figure of USD 2,500/yr (bachelor) and USD 2,000/yr (master) converted at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR — actual figure varies significantly by department; verify exact program fee before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma + international exam scores (SAT/ACT, or YOS-equivalent score) + English proficiency for English-medium programs (TOEFL iBT 80+/IELTS 6.5+) or one-year Turkish prep for Turkish-medium programs
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering/science field + ALES or GRE + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 80+/IELTS 6.5+) + department interview for some programs
scholarshipDetails: ITU is a confirmed Türkiye Bursları host university; Bangladeshi applicants can receive full tuition waiver, monthly stipend, free housing, one-year Turkish language course, health insurance, and flight tickets. Apply via turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.

name: Koç University
tuitionNote: Per Koç University official tuition page (international.ku.edu.tr / registrar.ku.edu.tr) for 2025-2026: standard undergraduate tuition is USD 21,500/yr for most majors (Medicine USD 59,000/yr, Law USD 38,000/yr — not used here as representative figures). Converted USD 21,500 at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR. Master's figure (~USD 14,000/yr) is an estimate based on typical Turkish foundation-university graduate fee ratios (roughly 60-65% of undergraduate); exact graduate figure not confirmed from official source — verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma + SAT/ACT or equivalent international exam + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 90+/IELTS 6.5+) as Koç is fully English-medium; holistic admissions review
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree + GRE/GMAT (program-dependent) + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 90+/IELTS 6.5+) + letters of recommendation and statement of purpose

name: Sabancı University
tuitionNote: Per Sabancı University International Relations Office official announcement (sabanciuniv.edu, 2025-2026 academic year): annual tuition for international undergraduate students is USD 36,500/yr. Converted at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR. Master's tuition figure not separately confirmed from an official source for this batch — bachelor figure reused as a placeholder per project convention; verify actual graduate tuition before publishing, as it is likely program-dependent and may differ substantially. Note: every international applicant is automatically reviewed for merit scholarships (25-100% tuition waivers), so net cost for many students is materially lower than the sticker price quoted here.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma + SAT/ACT or equivalent + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 90+/IELTS 6.5+); Sabancı uses a flexible/no-major-at-entry liberal-arts-style admission model
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field + GRE/GMAT (program-dependent) + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 90+/IELTS 6.5+) + interview for some programs

name: Bilkent University
tuitionNote: CONFLICTING SOURCES — verify before publishing. Some third-party aggregator sites cite a 2025-2026 undergraduate fee as low as USD 5,750/yr (VAT included), while other sources citing Bilkent's own admitted-cohort fee schedule for 2026-2027 list USD 16,300-18,400/yr (with 10% VAT) depending on admission year. Used USD 17,300/yr (mid-range of the higher, more official-looking figure) converted at 1 USD = 0.92 EUR as the representative figure, but the USD 5,750 figure from other aggregators could not be reconciled and may reflect an outdated or partial-scholarship rate. Master's tuition not separately confirmed; bachelor figure reused as placeholder. Confirm directly via w3.bilkent.edu.tr before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: High school diploma + SAT/ACT or equivalent + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 80+/IELTS 6.5+) as Bilkent is fully English-medium; merit-based scholarships widely awarded at admission
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree in relevant field + ALES/GRE (program-dependent) + English proficiency (TOEFL iBT 80+/IELTS 6.5+)
